t: The Brenner 5Ltr concentrated degreaser removes stubborn grease, oil and grime from washable surfaces. Formulated for heavy-duty cleaning, this professional formula is ideal for mechanics, valeters and workshop floors. The liquid works rapidly on concrete, stainless steel, plastic and sealed wood to clear dirt without damaging surfaces. Trade professionals can clean workshops and garages quickly, saving time on tough jobs.
b: Removes Everyday Soils, Stains & Grime With Ease
